CHAPTER ONE             OUR EVALUATION AND                         第一章           我們的判斷與堅守
                        DETERMINATION

In 2019, as per our evaluation from two years ago, the volatile    2019年，如我們兩年前的判斷，浮躁的資產價
asset price bubble is getting cleaned up and the rate of           格泡沫正在出清、收益率持續下降，各種不確
return continues to drop, with various uncertainties becoming      定性已成為確定的事實。中國已經從體量規模
a reality. As China has already shifted from the high-speed        高速增長進入到存量結構加速創新的時代，我
growth in size and volume into an era of acceleration of           們堅定地看好中國經濟的強大韌性，堅定地看
innovations, we are steadfast in being optimistic about Chinese    好動能轉換的發展後勁。
economy’s sturdiness and resilience, and optimistic about the
development brought by the shift.

It was a good opportunity to increase investment at the            行業的低谷是加大投資的良機，艱苦的環境是
downturn of industry, with the steps to breakthrough paved         向上突破的台階。為此，團隊全體成員「躬身入

CORPORATE GOVERNANCE PRACTICES                                       企業管治常規

 Goal 1 requires that economic growth be inclusive in order to provide a sustainable employment environment and promote equity. The
 Group’s two segments - Carpark operation and Fund management, build a competitive edge through product uniqueness and resource
 endowment, and fully take into account responsible investment, impact investment, community investment and identification of human
 rights risks in the value chain in its investment decisions and operational development. Meanwhile, the Group realises that it is its employees
 that make the company different. Therefore, the Group respects the rights of workers in business operations, provides employees with
 suitable job opportunities and stable work benefits and fully meets their reasonable expectations, aiming to achieve a sustainable, fair, and
 socially responsible operating model to enhance its capability to innovate and advance in the future.


 目標1要求經濟增長必須具有包容性，才能提供可持續的就業環境並促進公平。本集團停車場經營和基金管理兩個細分領域，通過獨特的產
 品力和資源禀賦構築競爭優勢，在投資決策與營運發展中把責任投資，影響投資，社區投資和識別價值鏈中的人權風險充分考慮。同時，本
 集團深知是我們的員工造就了我們的與眾不同。因此，本集團在企業營運中尊重勞動者的權利，為僱員提供合適的工作機遇和穩定的工作
 待遇，對其合理的要求充分採納，目的實現可持續化、公平、具有社會責任心的運營模式，從而增強我們的創新及在未來不斷向前發展的能
 力。

Year 2019 is the fifth year of 99 Public Welfare Day and the second year of our participation in philanthropy. In 2018, around 50 children from
Caofeidian were invited to Shougang Park in Beijing to experience the journey of the Winter Olympics, which paved our path to public welfare.
In July 2019, the Everlove Foundation launched the Youth Dreamer-S Plan, inviting 20 orphans from Jilin to Beijing pursuing their dreams.

During the four days, the volunteers took these children on the journey to explore their dreams. With the help of doctors from Shougang
Hospital, students received laparoscopic simulation training, basic first aid and laboratory knowledge. In the automotive technology R&D Centre
and other places, 20 students had classes about environmental protection, drama, jigsaw puzzles, dubbing and painting, created the works
with their hands and learned the development history from fueled vehicles to electric vehicles. On the last day, the students made a splendid
report show with carefully rehearsed performances at the headquarter of Shougang Fund. In the end, the volunteers guided the students to
visit the five-storey office of Shougang Fund and experienced first-hand the high-tech items such as digital projection in Shougang Park.

2019年是99公益日的第五年，也是我們參與公益的第二個年頭。2018年，曹妃甸的近50位孩子受邀來到北京首鋼園區體驗冬奧之旅，打開了
我們公益之路。在二零一九年七月，慈心長青公益基金發起了少年夢想家-S計畫，邀請來自吉林的20位孤兒來到北京，尋找他們的夢想。

在四天的時間裡，志願者他們帶著孩子們展開了關於夢想的第一次實地探索。在首鋼醫院醫生的幫助下，學生學習了腹腔鏡模擬培訓，急救
常識，檢驗科知識等。在汽車技術研發中心等地，20名學生體驗了環保，戲劇，拼圖，配音，畫等素質課堂，並通過雙手創造屬於自己的鮮活作
品，並學習了燃油車到電動車的發展史。最後一天，學生們在首鋼基金總部帶著精心排練的節目，開始了一場溫馨的匯報演出。結束後，志願
者引導學生們去到首鋼基金共五層的辦區參觀，親身體驗了首鋼園區數字投影等高科技。

            has the ability to affect those returns through                     通過其權力指導實體活動從而影

            Subsidiaries are fully consolidated from the date                   實體。附屬公司自控制權轉移至

      to the offshore trading profits of iron ore claimed by              港 利 得 稅 約 港 幣49,061,000元（「海 外
      the Group in prior years (the “Offshore Claim”). The                聲請」）。本集團於2016年報告期結束後
      Group received tax assessment demanding notes on the                接獲稅務局就海外聲請發出的評稅通知
      Offshore Claim (the “Assessment”) issued by the Inland              書（「評稅」）。儘管本集團管理層已對評
      Revenue Department subsequent to the end of the                     稅提出反對，惟由於本集團管理層不能

      the Group lodged an objection against the Assessment,               度之香港利得稅港幣49,061,000元作出
      provision for prior years’ Hong Kong profits tax of                 撥備。
      HK$49,061,000 was made as the management of the
      Group was uncertain about the probability of the success
      of the objection.


      In 2018 and 2019, the abovementioned tax objection                  於2018年及2019年，上述稅項反對尚未
      has not yet been resolved, resulting in the tax certificates        解決，導致因應稅務局要求購買約港幣

      as requested by the Inland Revenue Department. The                  相應之應付利得稅乃按淨額基準於本集
      balance of tax certificates and corresponding profits tax           團應付稅項內呈列，本集團擁有合法可
      payable were presented on a net basis within tax payable            強制執行權利及有意按淨額基準結算。
      as the Group had a legally enforceable right to and
      intent to settle on a net basis.


      China enterprise income tax                                         中國企業所得稅

     •     assesses property valuations movements when                  •      評估物業估值相較於過往年度估
           compared to the prior year valuation;                               值的變動；


     •     holds discussions with the internal valuation team           •      主持與內部估值小組及獨立估值
           and independent valuers.                                            師的討論。


     Valuation techniques                                               估值技術
     The Group obtains valuations for its investment                    本集團至少每年一次就其投資物業取得
     properties at least annually.                                      估值。


     At the end of each reporting period, the directors                 於各報告期末，董事均經考慮最近期估
     update their assessment of the fair value of each                  值更新彼等就各物業的公允價值的評
     property, taking into account the most recent valuations.          估。董事於合理公允價值估計範疇內釐
     The directors determine a property’s value within a                定物業價值。
     range of reasonable fair value estimates.


     The best evidence of fair value is current prices in               公允價值的最佳憑證為相類似的物業
     an active market for similar properties. Where such                在活躍市場的當時價格。如未能取得有
     information is not available the directors consider                關資料，董事則會考慮來自多方面的資
     information from a variety of sources including:                   料，包括：


     •     current prices in an active market for properties            •      不同性質的物業於活躍市場的當
           of different nature or recent prices of similar                     時價格或類似物業在比較不活躍
           properties in less active markets, adjusted to                      市場中的近期價格（ 須就反映上
           reflect those differences                                           述差異作出調整）


     •     discounted cash flow projections based on reliable           •      根據未來現金流量的可靠估計而
           estimates of future cash flows                                      預測的折算現金流量


     •     capitalised income projections based upon a                  •      根據物業估計市場收入淨額以及
           property’s estimated net market income, and a                       源自市場證據分析的資本化比率
           capitalisation rate derived from an analysis of                     而預測的資本化收入。
           market evidence.


     There were no changes to the valuation techniques                  年內，估值技術並無變動。
     during the year.
